'''Churg Anaris Hej''' was the Deputy Head of [[Imperial Procurement]] shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Hej made a report regarding the stockpiling of [[Beskar/Legends|beskar]] and the possible difficulty of acquiring [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] metalsmiths to work on the beskar.<ref name="IC 501st" />
